bullets.text: Microsoft Named Leader in IDC MarketScape - Microsoft has been recognized as a leader in application streaming and enterprise browsers.
Cloud Security at a Tipping Point - IDC reports a significant rise in cloud security incidents, urging a rethink in strategies.
AI's Dual Role in Cybersecurity - AI can enhance security or introduce new threats, emphasizing the need for careful management.
Europe's Cybersecurity Regulations Matter - New EU regulations are crucial for protecting critical infrastructure against cyber threats.
Windows 11 Insider Preview Updates - New features in Windows 11 Insider Preview Build 27982 enhance user experience and security.
Generative AI Transforms Security Operations - Microsoft Security Copilot leverages AI to enhance security operations and incident response.
New Developer Resources for Microsoft 365 - Microsoft enhances interoperability and data portability for developers integrating with Microsoft 365.
Microsoft Edge Introduces Passkeys - Edge now supports passkey saving and syncing, enhancing online security for users.
Novel Backdoor Uses OpenAI API - A new backdoor exploits OpenAI API for command-and-control, showcasing evolving cyber threats.
Behind the Universe Demo at GitHub - Microsoft showcases rapid app development using AI tools at GitHub Universe.
